scope: Reprove a conservative numerical upper for the growing-A Bordignon Theorem 1.2 constant directly from final Theorem 3.4 and equations (28)--(32). Correct the remainder normalization, preserve the final-published 2q factor that is absent from arXiv v1, maximize over the unknown Liu-Wang alternative, and compare the result with the H1c-1b.4c admissible envelope. Do not yet promote the parent Hypothesis 1(2), Proposition 9.2, SIV-08, or X_cert.

parameters.q_range: 2 <= q <= L^A; q=1 exact centered count is removed separately

source_corrections.low_height_equation_31_character_factor: final-published 2q preserved; arXiv-v1 display without q rejected
source_corrections.corollary_unknown_i: do not select i=6; use J=0 for each i and maximize all six alternatives
source_corrections.high_zero_common_lambda_reason: min of all eta_i and xi_(i+1) used by J=0 is eta_1=0.16

sigma0_source_bound.note: H here is the explicit-formula contour height

proof_cutoff.uniformity: termwise calculus gives decrease in L for fixed A; exact rational derivative-dominance checks hold at r=10^10, and at later dimension corners the critical ratios r/(log r)^2 and sqrt(r)/log r increase

numerical_corner_diagnostic.role: regression diagnostic only; rational corner inequalities and calculus carry the proof
